issue.title: Enforcing mode for the memory_change_uncovered finalizer guard after its advisory soak

task_type_fields.proposal: Add an enforcing mode to the advisory finalizer memory guard (src/sase/finalizers/commit_memory_guard.py, code memory_change_uncovered). When an agent launched from an approved plan changes a sase/memory/** note that no accepted memory decision covers (its own, or inherited from its epic), refuse the whole publication and list the uncovered paths instead of only warning. Decide after the advisory guard has soaked: check how often it fires and whether it gives false positives (the sase-1hi land audit already found one candidate, hand-written nested AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files counted as generated outputs).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan Decisions (sase-1hi, plan section 5.7) shipped the guard advisory and unflagged on purpose: agent declarations have no warning channel, so Bryan decides on enforcement only after a soak period. Proposed by sase-1hi.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2).

issue.creation_reason: Plan Decisions shipped the memory guard advisory-only by design; enforcement is a deferred decision for Bryan once soak data exists.
